adcsr-x4.takeHomeTagline:
— this exact code as one typed function, no UI; the CLI is an argument shell over it, and
the GUI runs the same resolver on the photo you pick.
adcsr-x4.takeHomeNote:
Big photos? Inputs are tiled and feather-blended internally; `maxInputSide` (default 512)
caps the input first so a full-res phone photo can't produce a gigapixel result.

voxcpm-0.5b.snippetResultComment: // audio.samples: 16 kHz mono PCM in [-1, 1] — play it or write a WAV
voxcpm-0.5b.takeHomeTagline:
— this exact code as one typed function, no UI; the CLI is an argument shell over it, and
the GUI drives the same `KitSpeaker(catalog:)` and plays the samples.
voxcpm-0.5b.takeHomeNote:
Live playback? `synthesizeStreaming(_:onChunk:)` hands you ~0.5 s chunks as they decode,
so audio starts before the whole clip exists. The WAV container is your app's territory
(the runner ships a 20-line writer).
